offers_products.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condos in communities across 12 states.

offers_services.reason: Homebuilding is the core; mortgage (Home Funding) and title services are minor side lines supporting home sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells homes to entry-level, move-up and resort lifestyle homebuyers and renters (Yardly).

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual homebuyers and renters; no organizational buyers evident.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from one-time home sales; rental via Yardly is a small part.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and depend on mortgage rates and confidence.

big_ticket.reason: A home is described as one of the largest investments of a person's life.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for built homes, a physical product, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual households purchasing homes.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder holding land and inventory but no plants or fleets; it is not a heavy-asset operator like utilities.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call because land inventory is large, though it lacks plants or fleets.
